privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This is a personal, non-commercial website. It does not directly collect personal data from its visitors.
privacy.hostingBody:
This website uses the services of Cloudflare, Inc. as a Content Delivery Network (CDN), security proxy, and edge computing platform (Cloudflare Workers). As part of these services, Cloudflare technically processes certain connection data (IP address, browser type, pages visited, HTTP headers) to ensure the security, performance, and proper functioning of the website.
Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and applies the Standard Contractual Clauses for data transfers outside the European Union. For more information on how Cloudflare processes data, please see their privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
privacy.analyticsBody: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure traffic. This tool does not set any cookies, does not use fingerprinting, and does not collect data that could personally identify visitors. The data collected (page views, aggregated country of origin, device type) is used solely to understand how the website is used. No further processing of this data is performed.
privacy.cookiesBody:
This website does not set tracking cookies. Cloudflare may set a strictly necessary technical cookie (__cf_bm) for anti-bot protection purposes, which is exempt from consent requirements under CNIL guidelines.
This website uses the browser's local storage (localStorage) to store technical data strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the application, such as your user preferences and an opaque identifier used to maintain session continuity. This identifier does not allow you to be personally identified and is not associated with any collection of personal information. This data remains stored locally on your device and can be deleted at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.rightsBody:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and object to the processing of your personal data.
To exercise these rights, you can contact me via the form available at: https://www.alea.net/contact
You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (in France: CNIL, www.cnil.fr).

help.title: Welcome to Conclave
help.remoteDescription: Open this room in a new browser window or on your phone to get a dedicated admin remote. Use it to reveal votes, reset rounds, manage timers, and cast your own vote from anywhere.
help.shareDescription: Share the room link or QR code with your team so they can join instantly.
help.tasksDescription: Create a task list to vote on items one by one, or use ad-hoc mode for quick standalone votes.
help.votingDescription: Use the admin sidebar (or the bottom bar on mobile) to reveal votes, reset the round, or start a timer. Participants vote by picking a card.
help.settingsDescription: Anonymous voting, auto-reveal on timer, custom card decks, and task lists to vote on items one by one — configure these in the admin panel.
